description: Knowledge and utilities for creating animated GIFs optimized for Slack. Provides constraints, validation tools, and animation concepts. Use when users request animated GIFs for Slack like "make me a GIF of X doing Y for Slack."

scenarios.scenario: A product manager wants to celebrate a major feature release by adding a custom animated celebration badge to their team's Slack workspace.
scenarios.user_query: Can you generate a 128x128 animated GIF of a golden party popper with colorful confetti shooting out for a Slack emoji?

scenarios.scenario: A DevOps engineer needs an animated indicator for their build bot to show that a deployment pipeline is actively running.
scenarios.user_query: I need a smooth looping animation of two interlocking mechanical gears spinning continuously on a dark slate background.

scenarios.scenario: An HR coordinator wants a lively reaction emoji for peer appreciation messages in their company Slack channel.
scenarios.user_query: Make me a Slack emoji GIF of a pink heart that does a double-pulse heartbeat rhythm with a subtle glow.

scenarios.scenario: An incident commander wants a visual alert icon for urgent P0 outages posted in triage channels.
scenarios.user_query: Create an animated flashing red siren beacon that shakes slightly while rotating its light beam.

scenarios.scenario: A software engineer has a custom GIF that Slack rejected due to size limits and needs it optimized and validated.
scenarios.user_query: I made 'deploy_fail.gif' for a Slack reaction, but Slack says the file size is too large. Can you optimize the palette and validate it for Slack emoji upload?

scenarios.scenario: A community manager wants a friendly greeting graphic for automated onboarding messages.
scenarios.user_query: I need a cute animation of a yellow hand waving back and forth with a slight elastic bounce at the edges.

scenarios.scenario: A sales director wants a celebratory reaction icon to react to closed deals in the team channel.
scenarios.user_query: Generate a Slack GIF of a green dollar bill vibrating with little gold sparkles bursting outward.

scenarios.scenario: A scrum master needs a visual timer animation to nudge teammates to wrap up their standup updates.
scenarios.user_query: Could you create an animated clock face where the red minute hand rapidly ticks around 360 degrees in a smooth loop?

scenarios.scenario: A tech lead wants a distinctive approval stamp for PR reviews posted into the development Slack room.
scenarios.user_query: Create a 128x128 Slack reaction GIF with bold green text 'LGTM' that slams down into frame with a heavy bounce landing.

scenarios.scenario: An office manager wants a cozy morning reaction icon for the watercooler chat.
scenarios.user_query: I want an animated pixel-style coffee mug with swirling steam rising and fading out at the top.

scenarios.scenario: A QA tester uploaded a bug illustration and wants it converted into an animated Slack emoji for ticket tracking.
scenarios.user_query: Take this uploaded 'bug_icon.png' and create a Slack emoji GIF where it shakes violently side to side like it's panicking.

scenarios.scenario: A customer support lead wants an achievement visual when the team reaches zero unanswered tickets.
scenarios.user_query: I need an animation of an inbox tray that has paperwork sliding out and disappearing, ending with a shiny green checkmark popping up.

scenarios.scenario: A marketing specialist wants an eye-catching announcement banner GIF for their internal company Slack channel.
scenarios.user_query: Make a 480x480 message GIF for Slack featuring a megaphone sliding in from the left with pulsing sound waves emitting from it.

scenarios.scenario: A developer wants a spinning loading graphic to use as an animated status icon in chat.
scenarios.user_query: Please build a 10-frame looping animation of a multi-colored gradient ring spinning clockwise.

scenarios.scenario: An engineering manager wants a shiny star animation to reward teammates during weekly demo day shoutouts.
scenarios.user_query: Generate a Slack-ready emoji GIF of a 5-pointed gold star that rotates slowly while pulsing in size.

scenarios.scenario: A recruiter wants to celebrate new candidate acceptances in the hiring updates feed.
scenarios.user_query: Can you make an animated graphic of a fountain pen signing a contract with a burst of tiny stars appearing when the signature finishes?

scenarios.scenario: A growth hacker wants a high-energy rocket animation to post whenever daily active users hit a milestone.
scenarios.user_query: Create an animated GIF optimized for Slack showing a rocket blasting off vertically with flame particles spraying out the bottom.

scenarios.scenario: A customer success manager wants a firefighting animation for when critical support tickets are resolved.
scenarios.user_query: Make a small looping animation of a red fire extinguisher spraying a cloud of white foam that expands and dissolves.

scenarios.scenario: A workspace administrator wants to verify if a folder of custom GIFs meets all Slack emoji constraints.
scenarios.user_query: Check if 'thumbs_dance.gif' in my workspace conforms to Slack's emoji specs for dimensions, duration, and color count.

scenarios.scenario: A frontend designer wants an interactive toggle animation to demonstrate UI states in design team discussions.
scenarios.user_query: Create an animated pill toggle switch that slides smoothly from left (gray) to right (vibrant blue) using ease-out interpolation.

scenarios.scenario: A social committee lead wants a fun food reaction icon for ordering team Friday lunches on Slack.
scenarios.user_query: Can you make a Slack emoji GIF of a pizza slice spinning 360 degrees with dripping melted cheese?

scenarios.scenario: A security analyst wants an alert visual to accompany automated vulnerability disclosure notices.
scenarios.user_query: I need an animation of a silver padlock that starts open, then snaps shut abruptly with a subtle screen shake.

scenarios.scenario: A data engineer wants a graphic illustrating heavy server load when batch processing kicks off.
scenarios.user_query: Build a Slack-compatible GIF of a tiny brown hamster running frantically inside an animated spinning wheel.

scenarios.scenario: A project coordinator wants an animated visual showing progress across sprint milestones.
scenarios.user_query: Can you generate an animation where a horizontal progress bar fills up smoothly from 0% to 100% with a glowing front tip?

scenarios.scenario: An internal tools developer created a script outputting raw image frames and needs them assembled into an optimized Slack GIF.
scenarios.user_query: I generated 15 PIL frames in Python. How do I compile them into a 128x128 GIF using 48 colors optimized for Slack emoji?

scenarios.scenario: A technical writer wants an animated search graphic to highlight newly published documentation.
scenarios.user_query: Create a smooth animation of a magnifying glass scanning diagonally across a document with little blue sparkle accents.

scenarios.scenario: A team lead wants a vibrant celebratory burst GIF for acknowledging project completion in their department Slack.
scenarios.user_query: Make a Slack GIF of a central explosion with 20 multi-colored particles radiating outward and fading to transparent.

scenarios.scenario: A workplace experience coordinator uploaded the company logo and wants an animated badge for anniversary reactions.
scenarios.user_query: Here is 'acme_logo.png'. Can you make it zoom in from 20% to full size with a bouncy elastic finish for our Slack emoji collection?

scenarios.scenario: A gaming club organizer wants a glowing retro sign to react to match wins in their company leisure channel.
scenarios.user_query: I need a dark square animation with neon cyan and magenta text 'GG' that flickers like a faulty neon tube sign.

scenarios.scenario: A sysadmin wants an urgent warning GIF to accompany scheduled database maintenance alerts.
scenarios.user_query: Generate a 480x480 Slack message GIF showing a yellow hazard triangle with an exclamation mark pulsing rapidly against a diagonal-striped background.
